items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Special Indian slogan from way back, you know, the medicine man, what you call them? Hoodoo, witch doctor.

ctx.x: Well, what kind of stuff do they leave there?
I don't know what it could be. Special Indian slogan from way back, you know, the medicine man, what you call them? Hoodoo, witch doctor. And that's Indian, huh?
